newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam buys 213,000/T diesel for July-Sep.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam buys 213,000/T diesel for July-Sep.

text.p: State-owned Vietnam National Petroleum Import-Export Corp (Petrolimex) bought 10 diesel cargoes totalling 213,000 tonnes in its third quarter tender, up from 170,000 tonnes in the second quarter, industry sources said on Friday.
Petrolimex purchased four cargoes of diesel on a free-on board (fob) basis from refiners in Singapore and six cargoes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis from Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) and Hongai.
Sources said the awarded levels indicated a steep contango with prices July and August very much lower than in September.
Petrolimex is also still in talks with a seller to buy another cargo for September 20-25 delivery, c-and-f basis, which will be taken on a spot basis, sources said.

Traders said the prices awarded in the thurd quarter tender was significantly lower than in the second quarter. Fob prices for the second quarter were 10 cents per barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes, compared with a 10-to-30-cent discount in the third quarter.
C-and-f prices in the second quarter ranged between a premium of 95 cents and $1.15 per barrel to Singapore spot quotes, compared with 43-83 cents premiums in the third quarter.
South Korean refiner Yukong Ltd received the lion's share of the c-and-f awards with four cargoes sold at aggressive levels, sources said.
